title: Anthropic IPO page lists $70–78 price range, ~$968B implied valuation
summary: An Anthropic IPO page drew Hacker News attention, and a commenter summarizing the linked documents cited a $70–78 per-share price range \(roughly $74 midpoint\), an $85.3B gross deal size including a $26B private placement, and an implied market capitalization near $968B at 13.09B shares, trading as ANT on Nasdaq. The same commenter&\#x27;s reading listed Q3 2026 revenue of $17.0B, up 1,127% year over year, a run-rate of about $81B as of October 2026, and $900.9B in compute commitments through 2045. It also counted 11,900+ customers with at least $100K in trailing revenue, 1,900+ above $1M and roughly 250 above $10M, alongside about 40 million customers below $100K. These figures come from a Hacker News commenter&\#x27;s summary of the filing documents rather than independently verified reporting, and the item supplied no source content of its own.
